text:
This summary covers the period from 2026-05-29 to 2026-06-04, encompassing 73 orders processed by ROBI. Of these, 12 were delivered, 12 delivered with warnings, and 49 resulted in a failed status. The average fetch time was 54 seconds, with a median of 58 seconds, and ROBI primarily handled pens (25), t-shirts (24), water bottles (12), and balls (12) during this time.

Notably, ROBI experienced a high number of failures this week, with [[reachability]]_failed occurring 25 times, [[no-valid-depth]] 12 times, and [[handover]]_failed 12 times, alongside 12 [[search-exhausted]] events. A total of 50 retries were recorded across all orders, with 25 orders specifically requiring a [[retry]]. Furthermore, ROBI issued 252 collision warnings, indicating a significant level of interaction with the environment.
